subject.title: [Feature]: Make managed browser launch degrade cleanly when no display server is available

question: Should explicit headed no-display launches keep failing with an additive structured error contract, or should some explicit headed profiles be allowed to fall back to headless under a new policy?
rationale: Both paths are technically feasible, but fallback policy and the stable browser error envelope are user-visible compatibility/API decisions.

options.title: Add structured error only
options.body: Keep explicit headed mode fail-closed, preserve implicit fallback, and serialize a closed no-display reason/details object through routes and client.

options.title: Add policy-controlled fallback
options.body: Allow selected explicit headed profiles to fall back to headless, but require a clear profile/config policy and upgrade documentation.

options.title: Keep text-only behavior
options.body: Leave current behavior as-is, accepting that agents must string-match the remediation text.

recommendation.title: Add structured error only
recommendation.body: Keep explicit headed mode fail-closed, preserve implicit fallback, and serialize a closed no-display reason/details object through routes and client.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest browser surface history and is already assigned to the issue.
